name: dsh-frosted-electron
description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI frosted-glass desktop shell: one-click launch of the harness plus a borderless translucent window with adjustable opacity, archived-session viewer, mobile LAN control, and a chat/SSH/task-board tab bar. Self-contained distribution bundles node.exe + the full @deepseek-ai/dsh CLI.
